compute.cost_note: one small causal LM forward pass over the text (default TinyLlama); CPU works, GPU faster; weights download on first use

do_not_use_when: the surprisal tier (transformers + torch, about 1.5 to 2 GB) cannot be installed
you want an authorship or AI verdict; the evidence is about predictability, and bands are provisional
the text may be in the scoring model's training data (memorization lowers surprisal)

examples.description: Default-model surprisal audit with token windows

artifacts: Markdown surprisal report, or JSON envelope with --json (stdout or --out)

purpose: Standalone causal-LM surprisal audit (default TinyLlama). Reports the per-token surprisal series summary (mean, SD/variance, lag-k autocorrelation, skew, kurtosis, position of maximum, top-k most surprising tokens) and an optional token-window trajectory. Bands are illustrative only; the ClaimLicense requires a user baseline and licenses no AI-provenance verdict.
use_when: you want predictability-uniformity evidence (DivEye-style surprisal variance) for a draft outside the full variance_audit --tier4 run
